warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 4.00 + 4.00 (8.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.70 + 3.00 + 1.00 (7.70). Origin A1 (A at the top of every plan, 1 at the left). The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, all three S-03 views (partial), S-04, A-07 (x) and A-08 (y). Vector CAD PDF with no text layer - every value read off the rendered page.

The S-03 +4.42 roof-beam plan does not put a beam on row B: its middle row is A'''' (3.35), printed 3.35 + 0.35 against the 3.70 A-B bay on S-03 and again on S-04, where the ridge line sits. Posts C1 stand on that row at 1''' (2.00), 1'''' (3.35) and 2' (4.65), and on 1''' at B' (5.70).

2'' (5.40) is the only line not read off a printed dimension: the 'B2 ระดับ +0.13' stub under stair ST-01 ends 1.40 right of grid 2 with no dimension printed. Measured by proportion against grids 2 and 3 on the vector page (section 4 Span amendment 2026-08-29), flagged scaled_from_grid with a lower line confidence.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนน (A-07/A-08). Two levels carry the same printed label 'ระดับหลังอกไก่' (+5.58 and +6.36), so the value is kept in their ids. The printed z chain 1.00 + 3.42 + 1.15 + 0.78 = 6.35 against the printed total 6.36 and the labels +4.42 / +5.58 (difference 1.16) - transcribed as printed, not corrected.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06 plus A-07 and A-08 (building sections, for levels). S-05/S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, section sizes, slab thickness, stair riser) which stay on their elements. The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03 floor plan, A-04 roof plan, A-05/A-06 elevations, A-09, A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run; A-03 repeats the 1.60 + 2.40 x row and carries more dimension rows and room tags that are not recorded here.
